name: JLA Infraville Shoppers Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2013, JLA Infraville Shoppers Ltd is engaged in online services and allied activities.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
JLAISL does online trading and retailing of a range of products, including fabrics, clothing, furnishings, electronics, computers and their accessories, surgical instruments, and hearing aid accessories. It is also venturing into the Real Estate business.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.49 times its book value
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company has a low return on equity of 0.64% over last 3 years.
Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
